b.label: Noite Oficial dos OVNIs - the Brazilian 'Night of the UFOs', 19 May 1986

edges.label: The 1986 night is named in the Senate instrument that produced the 2022 special session
edges.note: RQS 193/2022 names the event: 'em 1986, quando ocorreu a hoje conhecida como "Noite Oficial dos UFOs no Brasil", quando 21 OVNIs esféricos de 100 metros de diâmetro cada foram perseguidos durante horas por nossos caças a jato.' The special session was held on 24 June 2022. [CORRECTED 14 Aug 2026: RQS 193/2022 is a request for a COMMEMORATIVE SPECIAL SESSION under Art. 199 RISF, approved 16 Mar 2022, held 24 Jun 2022 - not a records-seeking or compelling instrument. Its durable value is the content of its justificacao, which names Operacao Prato, the 1986 night, SIOANI and the archive reference BR DFANBSB ARX. These edges assert what the document NAMES, which is verifiable in its text and unaffected by its procedural nature, so the tier is unchanged. Any claim that the instrument COMPELLED disclosure would be false.]
